content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I designed a basic logic that manages a compressor based on feedback from an air pressure transmitter. The logic operates correctly, and I've included a running hours counter that also functions as intended. My issue is that whenever I modify the logic, the hours counter resets to zero. As I'm new to this, could anyone share a solution for this situation? I don't believe online editing is available for [product_name], but please let me know if I'm mistaken.

It's normal for the hours counter to be cleared during a program transfer for [product_name]. When you perform the transfer, a notification appears indicating the counter will be deleted. Make sure to record the counter value before transferring. Afterwards, you can manually re-enter the value through: Tools > Transfer > Hours counter.
Hello [user_name], I tried following your instructions but couldn't set the hour counter to the desired value. The current counter value is visible, but I'm unable to edit it.

Apologies, that was a mistake on my part. Before transferring the program, you should input the noted counter value as the initial value for the hours counter in the block properties. The counter will continue from this specified value.

analysis.insight_summary: Users value the hours counter and logic programming features in [product_name], but are unclear about how to handle the counter when updating or modifying their logic. The automatic reset of the hours counter after program transfer surprises inexperienced users, highlighting a need for clearer instructions on how to retain or restore values post-transfer.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a straightforward option to reset the hours counter to zero or another chosen value after modifying and transferring their logic, along with a simple process to set a new starting value.
